items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Hawk told me that somehow, they lucked up and got this break in that picture with Amos and Andy... He told me that himself.

ctx.x: He said he couldn't get him to listen. So he said one night, he finally got him to listen and he was surprised, too. Said he was, you know, really excited. So he says, "Wait a minute. What is that he got?" He was trying to see

how he had this voice, but he never did come up with it, you know how Duke had had these things voiced. So Hawk told me that somehow, they lucked up and got this break in that picture with Amos and Andy, "Check and Double Check," he said, "And after that, he wiped us completely out." He said, "He ain't looked back." You know, "Check and Double Check?" He said he was on his way. He told me that himself.
